chapter.heading: Clap Your Hands, All You PeoplesFor the choirmaster. A Psalm of the sons of Korah.
chapter.v:
Clap your
hands, all you peoples;shout unto God with a voice of triumph.

How awesome
is the LORD Most High,the great King over all the earth!

He subdues
nations beneath us,and peoples under our feet.

He chooses
our inheritance for us,the pride of Jacob, whom He loves.Selah

God has
ascended amid shouts of joy,the LORD with the sound of the horn.

Sing praises
to God, sing praises;sing praises to our King, sing praises!

For God
is King of all the earth;sing profound praises to Him.

God reigns
over the nations;God is seated on His holy throne.

The nobles
of the nations have assembledas the people of the God of Abraham;for the shields of the earth belong to God;He is highly exalted.
